history.summary: A large 1,765 sqft freehold 4BR at Beng Tong Mansion (D15) at $2.5M / $1,416 PSF, ~820m from Dakota MRT. A low PSF for freehold D15 but only 1 URA transaction, no built year, and a tiny mansion-block dev — effectively undiscoverable on liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: The $1,416 PSF is genuinely low for freehold D15 East Coast and the $2.5M quantum buys a big 1,765 sqft 4BR — value on paper. But just 1 URA txn and no built year make appreciation and resale completely unverifiable; a small mansion-style block has shallow exit liquidity, and at $2.5M the buyer pool already thins. score_1000 only 503 despite a high arena elo. Cheap-for-D15 but unprovable and illiquid.

No built year (likely older mansion block)
Tiny boutique development — shallow resale market
$2.5M quantum sits where the buyer pool starts thinning
